before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate average waiting time by month across departments.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('年月', as_index=False)['平均待ち時間'].mean()

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(monthly['年月'], monthly['平均待ち時間'], marker='o', label='平均待ち時間')
plt.xlabel('年月')
plt.ylabel('平均待ち時間')
plt.title('年月ごとの平均待ち時間')
plt.ylim(0, 60)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
